alex: Hey team — alex here, first day! :wave: Trying to build the runtime from source on Ubuntu 22.04 with an A100. Followed the README but the final link step fails.
alex: Build snippet:
```
[100%] Linking CXX executable bin/redwood_runtime
/usr/bin/ld: undefined reference to `cublasLtCreate'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

alex: nvcc --version -> CUDA 11.8, nvidia-smi -> Driver 535. Any quick checks? Is that driver/toolkit mismatch likely? Who should I bug for infra/driver help? @jamie @riley

jamie: welcome! :tada: first guess is a toolkit vs link issue. quick checklist:
- make sure /usr/local/cuda points to cuda-11.8 (or set CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH)
- run `ldconfig` after installing drivers/toolkit
- check `nvcc --version` and `nvidia-smi` CUDA compat table
If you don't want to mess with host, use our dev container: `docker run --gpus all -it --rm -v $PWD:/src redwood/runtime-dev:cuda11.8 /bin/bash`

riley: another common thing: missing kernel headers or driver reinstall can leave libs broken. try:
```
sudo apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r)
sudo apt-get install --reinstall nvidia-driver-535
```
Also check CMake picked up cublasLt: sometimes you need to point to the cuda lib dir, e.g. `-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-11.8`

morgan: run `ldd bin/redwood_runtime | grep cublas` — if you see "not found" that's your clue. Also check `/usr/local/cuda-11.8/lib64/libcublasLt.so` exists.

alex: thanks all — one more question: is cublasLt a separate lib that needs manual link flags? our CMake should handle it but maybe not for newer toolkits.

riley: cublasLt is a separate library (libcublasLt.so) but the CUDA package exposes it in the cublas package. If the linker can't find it it's usually because cmake found CUDA headers but not the lib dir (common with a stray /usr/local/cuda symlink). Check `ls -l /usr/local/cuda` and `ls /usr/local/cuda-11.8/lib64 | grep cublasLt`

infra-bot: CI Notice: PR #3421 runtime-build (linux/cuda) failed on link step — failing target: redwood_runtime — logs available: https://ci.internal/3421

aj alex: I tried jamie's container and also tried setting `-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-11.8` and exported `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-11.8/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH`. Re-ran cmake/make and build succeeded. :raised_hands:

jamie: awesome! :100: if you run into stray toolkits we have a short doc in docs/dev-setup.md about removing old cuda symlinks. ping me if you want a quick pairing on the last-mile tests.

alex: will do, thanks everyone — tagging this thread as solved for now. :)
